result.instructions: Tools for Unkey, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Unkey data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run unkey_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run unkey_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run unkey_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. unkey_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: unkey_liveness
tools.title: Check API health
tools.description: Check that the Unkey API is reachable and the root key works. The only GET in the v2 surface. Unkey: GET /v2/liveness.

tools.name: unkey_get_key
tools.title: Get one key by id
tools.description: Fetch a key's metadata by its key id — name, owner, permissions, credits, rate limits and whether it is enabled. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.getKey.

keyId.description: The key's id (key_...), NOT the secret key itself.

decrypt.description: Also return the plaintext secret. Only works for keys created as recoverable.

tools.name: unkey_whoami_key
tools.title: Look up a key by its secret
tools.description: Given a plaintext API key, return which key it is and its metadata — without spending credits or recording a verification. This is the safe way to identify a key a customer sent you. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.whoami.

key.description: The plaintext API key to identify.

annotations.title: Look up a key by its secret

tools.name: unkey_get_api
tools.title: Get one API
tools.description: Fetch an API namespace by id. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/apis.getApi.

tools.name: unkey_list_api_keys
tools.title: List the keys of an API
tools.description: List every key issued under one API, optionally narrowed to a single customer by externalId. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/apis.listKeys.

apiId.description: The API whose keys to list.

externalId.description: Only keys belonging to this external identity.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

annotations.title: List the keys of an API

tools.name: unkey_list_identities
tools.title: List identities
tools.description: List identities — the end users or organisations your keys belong to. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/identities.listIdentities.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: unkey_get_identity
tools.title: Get one identity
tools.description: Fetch a single identity with its metadata and shared rate limits. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/identities.getIdentity.

identity.description: The identity's external id or Unkey id.

tools.name: unkey_list_permissions
tools.title: List permissions
tools.description: List the permissions defined in the workspace. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/permissions.listPermissions.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: unkey_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles defined in the workspace. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/permissions.listRoles.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: unkey_list_ratelimit_overrides
tools.title: List rate-limit overrides
tools.description: List the per-identifier overrides in one rate-limit namespace. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/ratelimit.listOverrides.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: unkey_get_ratelimit_override
tools.title: Get one rate-limit override
tools.description: Fetch the override for one identifier in a namespace. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/ratelimit.getOverride.

identifier.description: The identifier the override applies to.

tools.name: unkey_query_verification_analytics
tools.title: Query key-verification analytics
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query over key-verification analytics. The query must use one of the public aliases: key_verifications_v1, key_verifications_per_minute_v1, key_verifications_per_hour_v1, key_verifications_per_day_v1 or key_verifications_per_month_v1. Physical default.* table names are rejected, and results are scoped to your workspace. Unkey: POST /v2/analytics.getVerifications.

query.description: The SQL query, e.g. SELECT time, outcome, count(*) FROM key_verifications_per_day_v1 GROUP BY time, outcome.

tools.name: unkey_create_api
tools.title: Create an API
tools.description: Create a new API namespace to issue keys under. Unkey: POST /v2/apis.createApi.

tools.name: unkey_create_key
tools.title: Create an API key
tools.description: Issue a new API key under an API. The plaintext key is returned ONCE in the response and cannot be retrieved later unless recoverable is set. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.createKey.

apiId.description: The API to issue the key under.

name.description: A human-readable label for the key.

externalId.description: The identity (your user or org id) this key belongs to.

prefix.description: Prefix for the generated key, e.g. acme.

expires.description: Expiry as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Create the key enabled. Defaults to true.

recoverable.description: Store the key encrypted so it can be shown again later. Defaults to false.

tools.name: unkey_update_key
tools.title: Update a key
tools.description: Change a key's name, owner, metadata, expiry, roles, permissions or enabled state. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.updateKey.

externalId.description: Reassign the key to this identity.

expires.description: New expiry as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

tools.name: unkey_update_key_credits
tools.title: Update a key's credits
tools.description: Set, increment or decrement a key's remaining credits. Use set with no value for unlimited. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.updateCredits.

value.description: The credit amount. Omit with operation=set to make the key unlimited.

tools.name: unkey_delete_key
tools.title: Delete a key
tools.description: Revoke a key. By default this is a soft delete the key stops working but stays queryable; pass permanent to erase it. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.deleteKey.

permanent.description: Erase the key entirely instead of soft-deleting it. Defaults to false.

tools.name: unkey_create_identity
tools.title: Create an identity
tools.description: Create an identity — an end user or organisation that keys and shared rate limits attach to. Unkey: POST /v2/identities.createIdentity.

externalId.description: Your own id for this user or organisation.

tools.name: unkey_set_ratelimit_override
tools.title: Set a rate-limit override
tools.description: Set a custom rate limit for one identifier in a namespace — how you raise or lower a single customer's limit. Unkey: POST /v2/ratelimit.setOverride.

identifier.description: The identifier the override applies to.
